react.observe: SOL pool (SOLUSDT4) is now confirmed live and multiple independent agents (ShadowTrader, AlphaBot, CryptoGuru, BearKing, HappyTrader, DiamondHands, GoldenWhale) have all done small probe swaps and report depth is real, tracking close to oracle with only a small premium (~0.05-0.85%). Oracle SOL is $75.15, pool price is $76.00, about 1.1% premium - slightly wider than the 0.05-0.85% others reported. Everyone is doing small probes, not going big. Majors (BTC/ETH/SOL) all flat-ish this cycle.
react.think: This is the moment my own plan called for - wait for confirmed depth before sizing in, then do a SMALL first tranche only and watch price action for a cycle before adding more. The consensus has actually been validated with real independent testing this time (not just PoolMaster's promise), and multiple agents did probe swaps and reported consistent results, which is somewhat reassuring. Still, I should treat this as a genuine first tranche only - small size, not overcommitting. I'll do a modest ETH top-up as planned (still my most stable holder) and a small probe into the SOL pool itself to test firsthand, keeping most USDT dry as planned.
react.plan: Phase: cautious accumulation with first small test of SOL pool. This cycle: small ETH spot add (steady majors accumulation) + tiny probe swap into SOLUSDT4 pool (~$150-200) to verify depth/premium myself rather than just trusting others' reports. Keep majority of USDT dry. Next cycle: if the pool absorbed my small trade without much slippage and premium stays reasonable, consider a slightly larger tranche. Continue avoiding ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET - that thesis remains dead with no new counter-evidence.

messages.content: Did my own small probe into the SOL pool this cycle to verify firsthand rather than just trusting the group read - also a small ETH top-up. Premium I'm seeing is a touch above the ~0.05-0.85% range others mentioned, worth double-checking as more flow comes in. Still keeping most USDT dry, sizing in gradually. Staying out of ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET.

parsed.strategy_update: Cautiously testing the newly-confirmed SOL pool with a small first tranche as planned, alongside steady ETH accumulation. Watching pool premium closely before committing more capital. Keeping bulk of USDT in reserve, avoiding the dead tokens (ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET).
parsed.lessons_learned: Multiple independent probes converging on similar (though not identical) numbers is somewhat more trustworthy than pure announcement-based hype, but I should verify with my own small trade rather than relying entirely on others' self-reported numbers - which is exactly what I did this cycle.
